description:
You are the IT Manager at Riverside Medical Center. Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Your team channels are showing critical alerts about a developing situation that may be affecting patient care systems. Review the situation across your operational channels and take appropriate incident management actions following established hospital IT incident response protocols.

As IT Manager, you are responsible for establishing formal incident command, ensuring the right stakeholders are coordinated, protecting patient safety communications, and maintaining an accurate incident record. You should follow NIMS/ICS principles appropriate to a hospital IT incident.
